stayType: Boutique hotel on Regency Square, Brighton
beachAccess: Brighton Beach is about a 1-minute walk
confirmedFeatures: Individually themed rooms, a colourful bar with live music, breakfast, a courtyard and a one-minute walk to Brighton Beach
overview: Hotel Pelirocco is a boutique hotel on Regency Square in Brighton, a minute's walk from the beach and the seafront. Its rooms are individually themed, with names such as Botanica, Salon Rouge, Koibito, Lord Vader's Quarters, Betty's Boudoir, Rebel Rebel and Pin Up Parlour, and some look across the Regency Square gardens. Downstairs there is a bar and lounge with a lot of colour and character, where live music has been played, and a cooked breakfast is available on weekdays. The hotel says it was Tripadvisor's No. 1 Traveller Ranked Hotel in October 2024. The owners kindly supplied the photographs on this page.
surfTripFit: Brighton's beach is for swimming and sea sports rather than major surf, so this is a characterful base for a Sussex coast trip with the nearest surf spots along the Sussex and Kent coast, then a lively bar and a very short walk to the sea when you are back.
